html.p: Source 10.0.1.220 generated 513 failed Windows authentication events involving the privileged Administrator account on mercury .
All observed events were Event ID 4625 with Logon Type 3 and reported an unknown username or bad password. No corresponding successful Event ID 4624 logon was observed.

The activity showed an approximately hourly recurrence pattern and was correlated with LDAP traffic toward mercury over TCP/389. The evidence is more consistent with an automated process or misconfigured service repeatedly using invalid credentials than with conventional high-rate brute-force activity.
The exact originating application could not be conclusively identified from the available telemetry.
